name: VSCBench
description: VSCBench is a dataset of 3,600 image-text pairs designed to evaluate safety calibration in vision-language models, addressing both undersafety and oversafety across image-centric and text-centric scenarios.
reputation: A recent benchmark from the safety-calibration literature that is gaining attention, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Focuses on safety calibration by evaluating both undersafety and oversafety; highlights trade-offs between safety calibration and model utility.
